text.tspan: After finishing task k, the mean score over the k−1 tasks learned before it, in units of (score − random) / (1 − random).
The just-learned task is excluded, because including it lets a method that merely learns the newest task well post a flattering curve.

tspan.tspan: The shaded band is the min-max over ours' 3 complete seeds.

text.tspan: The other three have one complete seed each so far, so they carry no band; their remaining seeds are still running.
